title: The Unlit Stars
text: Out here the stars are unlit, hanging cold and grey like dead lamps on threads of nothing. One hangs low enough to reach, if someone climbs. It turns slowly, as if looking for someone.

options.label: The quickest climbs to the low star, to bring it down.

outcomes.text: They bring it down, cold and heavy and humming.
They fall a long way, in a place with no ground.

options.label: The wisest tries to light it again so it may see what it seeks.

outcomes.text: It flickers. For a moment you can see the way home.

options.label: Do not look up; whoever it seeks, it is not you.

outcomes.text: Not looking is hard, and it keeps turning toward you.
